title: ae/video-calls-configuration
description: What the application supplies to video-calls: the collected settings and resolved secrets that make the server environment, the room prefix and participant passed to videoGrant, and the browser Video options.

enabled.description: false makes the environment empty so no grant is issued; defaults to true.

serviceUrl.description: Address of the LiveKit service; https becomes wss and http becomes ws.

keyReference.description: Secret reference resolved by the deployment to the LiveKit API key.

secretReference.description: Secret reference resolved by the deployment to the LiveKit API secret.

environment.description: The server environment videoGrant and listRooms read: videoEnvironment(settings, secrets), or LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET from the deployment's environment.

roomPrefix.description: Prefix of video room names including its separator; equals the room service's roomPrefix.

participant.description: The authenticated participant a grant is issued for; publish is false for spectators and no grant is issued for a display.

video.description: Options of the browser Video: canCapture () => boolean (false on a shared display), soundOn () => boolean, and modeEvent, the browser event name display-mode publishes.
